$comment: Configuration for windows/bootstrap.ps1 and the PowerShell profile. Paths are relative to the repo root unless they start with '~' or a drive letter.

git.$comment: 1Password's SSH agent listens on the openssh-ssh-agent named pipe. Git for Windows' bundled ssh cannot talk to a named pipe, so point git at the Windows OpenSSH client instead. This is the Windows equivalent of the SSH_AUTH_SOCK export in dotfiles/.zshrc.

mise.$comment: https://mise.jdx.dev/installing-mise.html - winget is the officially documented Windows install method.
